requirements.title: Data contract and reference-day fixture
requirements.acceptance: Independently map every required field and the complete reference day; resolve C01-C08 decisions that affect official output.

requirements.title: Version integrity, derived locks, and preservation
requirements.acceptance: Correction, cancellation, concurrency, unauthorized mutation, lineage, source preservation, and approved-current aggregation pass end-user scenarios.

requirements.title: Reference-form parity
requirements.acceptance: Excel/PDF values, fields, labels, roles, unknown semantics, long text, pagination, printing, timezone, and watermark match the agreed reference form.

requirements.title: Filters, complete result set, and totals
requirements.acceptance: API, UI, URL, Excel, pagination, and totals represent one complete filtered queryset with correct units and unset semantics.

requirements.title: Independent numeric, formula, and print reconciliation
requirements.acceptance: Independent expected values, recalculation logs, mapping, checksums, screenshots, and discrepancy decisions prove Excel/PDF parity and measured download time.

requirements.title: Delivery and initial employer acceptance bundle
requirements.acceptance: A fixed release/SHA, guide, inputs/expected values, checksums, role/device/language/cross-project tests, and explicit employer review are recorded.

summary: A.1 is the next delivery phase. The delivery plan marks daily Excel/PDF export implemented but A.1.01-A.1.04 remaining. The audit expands the remaining work into B01-B06; 42 atomic stories and the H/D/W/E/Q/X requirement register are linked in the saved report. Live localhost delivery-plan verification was unavailable during discovery.
